summary: InterCure Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a binding term sheet for a private placement of approximately NIS 22 million ($7 million) via 7.9 million units (one ordinary share + one warrant) at NIS 2.75 per share, a premium to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange closing price. The placement is led by the CEO and pharma-focused hedge funds, requiring shareholder approval only for the CEO's participation. No underwriter is used; completion is subject to definitive agreements and customary conditions. This is a financing transaction, not a transformative special situation; no deal-arb or strategic review angle exists.
